summary: A target region that accepts or rejects a dragged item, optionally reparenting it.
overview: The other half of dragging. It can filter by tag, so a weapon slot rejects a potion, and can reparent the dropped item so it stays where it landed.
useCases: Equipment slots accepting only the right item type.
Puzzle targets that accept one specific piece.

params.tuning: Empty means accept anything. A typo here rejects everything, silently.
On, the item becomes a child and stays. Off, it returns to its origin even though the drop succeeded — which is what you want when the zone is a command rather than a container.

gotchas.title: It needs to be raycastable
gotchas.body: A zone with no raycast target graphic is never under the pointer, so drops always fail.
